_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/*.md must trace to this file (or a later commit that bumps it) -- see sim/README.md 'PDK pin' section. Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet. Follows sg13g2-bandgap/sim/pdk.json's and sg13g2-opamp/sim/pdk.json's shape (same PDK, same pinned release).
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far._comment: sim/hbt-characterization/ (issue #7) is the first sim/ experiment in this repo, and it instantiates only npn13G2 -- a native ngspice VBIC (level=9) bipolar model, NOT a Verilog-A/OSDI-compiled device, needing no OSDI toolchain at all. sim/biasref-topology/ (issue #33 / DR-0003) is the first experiment to instantiate a MOS device: sg13_hv_pmos, the PSP103.6 Verilog-A/OSDI device, per DR-0001's binding 'any MOS in the bias network must be the HV flavour' constraint (1.98 V > the LV MOS 1.6 V VDS/VGS maximum). The OSDI build/load step that need finally materialized is sim/tools/build-osdi.sh, ported from sg13g2-bandgap (the fleet precedent) rather than invented here. sim/biasref-topology/ (issue #33) also probes the pnpMPA substrate-PNP diode (native Gummel-Poon level=1, cornered by the same cornerHBT.lib sections via sgp_mpa_* scalars, no compile step).
device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far.npn13G2: native VBIC (Rev. 1.15, level=9) SPICE model card, sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib -- loaded directly via cornerHBT.lib's .LIB sections, no compile step
device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far.pnpMPA: native Gummel-Poon (level=1) substrate-PNP card (diode-characterized per sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib's own header), sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib -- loaded via the same cornerHBT.lib sections (sgp_mpa_* scalars), no compile step; instantiated only in sim/biasref-topology/ probes
device_models_used_by_this_repo_so_far.sg13_hv_pmos: PSP103.6 Verilog-A via OSDI (sg13_hv_pmos subckt, cornerMOShv.lib mos_* sections), requires sim/tools/build-osdi.sh -- HV flavour per DR-0001's 1.6 V LV-MOS constraint; instantiated only in sim/biasref-topology/ probes so far

osdi_toolchain._comment: Pins belong to sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (the single source of truth); this block restates them as a greppable fact sheet, matching sg13g2-bandgap's sim/pdk.json shape.
osdi_toolchain.script: sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (ported from sg13g2-bandgap's, the fleet precedent for this same pinned PDK)
osdi_toolchain.checked: 2026-09-21 (models present + loadable per the port's --check; see sim/biasref-topology/records/)
